user.title: ADS-B receiver
user.description: URL of the aircraft.json file published by readsb / tar1090, for example http://RECEIVER/tar1090/data/aircraft.json or http://HOST:PORT/data/aircraft.json for ultrafeeder.

data.notify_lost: Also notify when the flight leaves range

data_description.callsigns: Callsign as transmitted (ICAO code, e.g. FBU711 for French Bee BF711), registration (F-HREU) or ICAO hex. End with * for a prefix match (FBU* = every French Bee flight).
data_description.max_seen: Seconds without any message from the aircraft before it is no longer considered in range.
data_description.notify: Phones, tablets or other notify services that receive an alert when a watched flight comes into range. Leave empty to only use the entities and events.

error.invalid_data: The URL answered but is not a readsb / tar1090 aircraft.json (no 'aircraft' list).
